title: Three estimates of the carbon dioxide from half an hour of Netflix, 2019
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic axis, grams of carbon dioxide attributed to watching 30 minutes of Netflix: 1,600 in the figure drawn from The Shift Project's July 2019 report, 200 after The Shift Project corrected a bit-and-byte error in June 2020, and 18 in George Kamiya's updated IEA estimate for 2019 at the world's average electricity mix. Data: IEA, The carbon footprint of streaming video: fact-checking the headlines, December 2020.
heading: GRAMS OF CO2 PER HALF HOUR OF NETFLIX · LOG SCALE
